text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning countless races 
together with Yukino Bijin—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, it looks like a castle! I can't 
believe I get to come to a place like 
this...!

Using the ticket Yukino Bijin won in the 
lottery, we came to a hot spring inn.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"I just love hot springs, y'know! It's 
like, my whole body just melts away..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes. There's a trick to it, like this...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You completely relax your whole body and 
just surrender yourself to the hot water. 
Floating gently along...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When you do that, you can totally feel it 
melting away~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
However, ya gotta be careful de-gansu! If 
you let your guard down, your brain'll go 
"plop" too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes, gansu...

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
“—Wait, hey, isn't that girl... Yukino 
Bijin-chan?”

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
Wah, you're right! Oh gosh, should we ask 
for a photo? And then let's post it on 
Umastagram!

Yukino Bijin's popularity, sparked by 
another boom, showed no signs of fading. 
Per her wishes, she had usually handled 
things herself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer. I—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text: Ah... pardon?
choice_data_list: I'd like to let Yukino rest today.

text_block_list.text:
She finds joy in interacting with her 
fans. Yet, for today at least, I wished 
she could forget her surroundings just 
like when she's simply being herself.
choice_data_list:
Could you please pretend you didn't 
notice?

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true... I'm sorry, I got a 
little carried away.

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I won't write it anywhere! I'm 
sorry, Yukino-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Thank ya kindly for lookin' 
out for me.
choice_data_list: I was the one who hated it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh!?
choice_data_list:
Because I want to take my time talking 
with Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah, w-well, um...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we head out!?
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah. That was a fine bath, it sure 
was~...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeees. As you can see~.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Getting to have the whole bath all to 
myself... man, that was one crazy 
luxurious treat.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"One day, I wanna bring my family, the 
folks back in the village, and Mifuyu-chan 
here too."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta work hard enough to rent out 
this entire inn!
choice_data_list: So you've found a new dream, huh.
You've found a new dream, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Heheh, yes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...A dream, huh.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I... have another new dream I'd like to 
reach for, too.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: N-Never mind, forget I said anything!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, right! That reminds me, 
Mifuyu-chan asked me to send her some 
pictures of the inn!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll go take a quick photo!

"It's a bit late right now. If she goes 
off somewhere, it might be dangerous for 
her all alone... With that in mind, I 
decided to follow after her."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —N-No way, I really can't say it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because Trainer-san, you were so freakin' 
cool just now...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can look you in the face 
and say, "Please stay with me from now 
on"~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Auu, I know. I know, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer's waiting for me, so catch you 
later! ...I'm not running away, seriously! 
Good night, Mifuyu-chan."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Ya just had to go and provoke me, 
didn'tcha—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: T-Trai-Trai...!
choice_data_list:
...I'm looking forward to working with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees~...

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Yukino Bijin...
